formulas.inputs: f_J, f_LU, f_S, f_R: the cell's median fractions of the instrumented wall (instruction fractions for n < 128); f_chain = f_R + f_S (eight right-hand sides and eight solves); for matrix-free cells f_S is the sum of the solve-interval fractions and f_J = f_LU = 0
formulas.assumptions: upper bounds: zero overhead, perfect scaling, unchanged step count and unchanged error
formulas.a_level_structured_tableau: S = 1 / (1 - (1 - L/8) f_chain), L in {4, 5, 6}; the present tableau has depth 8 (theory S1), bound 1.0; theory S9 excludes L = 4 for a stiffly accurate order-5 tableau
formulas.b_speculative_jacobian_lu: saving = min(f_J + f_LU, f_chain / 4), S = 1 / (1 - saving); r = (f_J + f_LU) / f_chain. Also the variant without step-size prediction (theory S6): saving = min(f_J, f_chain / 4)
formulas.b_gate_list_for_V07_stage_b: cells with 0.15 <= r <= 0.92 and plain wall per accepted step (median plain wall / accepted steps) >= 500 microseconds; each entry carries its admissibility label
formulas.e_parallel_dense_lu: S = 1 / (1 - f_LU (1 - 1/P)), P in {2, 4, 6}; dense cells only
formulas.f_shared_krylov_basis: matrix-free cells only: S = 1 / (1 - sum over stages 2..8 of the solve-interval fractions); the JVP part of that sum is reported separately
formulas.g_parallel_rhs: S = 1 / (1 - f_R (1 - 1/P)), P in {2, 4, 6}; exploratory variant with the right-hand sides inside a finite-difference Jacobian (f_R + f_J) and, matrix-free, with the JVP (f_R + f_JVP)

reading: every bound is an upper bound of the whole-step speed-up under zero overhead, perfect scaling and an unchanged step count; a bound computed from a diagnostic_only row is diagnostic

v07_stage_b_gate.condition: 0.15 <= (f_J + f_LU) / f_chain <= 0.92 and plain wall per accepted step >= 500 microseconds

g_parallel_rhs_exploratory.what: right-hand sides of the stages and of the finite-difference Jacobian in parallel
